title: [SOA] Skip content extraction for image attachments
summary: The Sales Order Agent now skips content extraction for image attachments and uses their stored text content instead, improving processing reliability while maintaining relevance filtering for all attachments.
key_points: Image attachments bypass the extraction model (which rejects them) and use pre-stored text content
New IsImageAttachmentContentType function identifies standard and non-standard image MIME types
Non-image attachments continue through the existing extraction and system-ID marker check path
Relevance evaluation still applies to all attachments regardless of extraction bypass
Change is marked temporary pending future extraction model support for images
